description: Lab values: units, conversion to a canonical unit, and the physiologically plausible range in the canonical unit (3b contract, decision 3). Used to infer an unstated unit (only one unit gives a plausible value -> use it and state the assumption) and to reinterpret an implausible registry unit. An analyte is used only when status is 'verified' (every factor and the plausible range have a checked source); otherwise every comparison involving it is unknown. `reference` is the checked adult reference interval (low = lowest, high = highest across sexes); it is not itself the plausible range.
